text.name: nx_menu_densityEnabled_tooltip
text.text: What wheels do to the ground: dry/wet mud spray off every driven wheel on soil contact, terrain ruts under slip, wheel sink in soft soil, and cultivator/grubber paint on owned farmland. Skips planters, seeders, plows and other tool categories. Does not damage planted field crops or surrounding foliage.

text.name: nx_menu_dustEnabled_tooltip
text.text: Master switch for the dust scaling system. When off, vanilla particle behaviour is restored on every implement.

text.name: nx_menu_dustMultiplier_tooltip
text.text: Global intensity for all dust effects (plow, cultivator, combine, mower, wheels, etc.). 100% is the engine default, 200% is the mod default.

text.name: nx_menu_implementDustMultiplier_tooltip
text.text: Extra multiplier applied on top of the global dust multiplier, but only to towed/attached implement dust (plow, cultivator, sowing machine, roller, weeder, mower, mulcher, windrower, baler, and the combine/forager header cutter). Self-propelled vehicle dust (combine chopper plume, grain cleaning, forage harvester) and wheel kick-up are unaffected — those track the global slider alone. 100% means no extra adjustment; set above to amplify implements only, below to dial them back.

text.name: nx_menu_plowingEnabled_tooltip
text.text: Stabilises wheel physics when one side of a tractor drops into a furrow — narrower wheel collider and stronger suspension damping on the lower side to reduce arcade-style bouncing. Any individual wheel riding down in a furrow also gets a thin collider so the furrow walls can't catch it.

text.name: nx_menu_wheelPhysicsEnabled_tooltip
text.text: How mud and slip affect the wheel: reduced grip on wet soil, viscous brake drag in mud, anti-bounce suspension in furrows, and a slip-burst boost to mud spray. Diff/4WD and wide/track tires reduce damage; heavy/wet conditions lower the threshold.

text.name: nx_menu_realisticEngineEnabled_tooltip
text.text: Couples engine state to physics. When the wheels are sinking and slipping on field, the engine target RPM climbs proportional to how stuck the vehicle is — simulating the drivetrain spinning free with no traction, the classic stuck-vehicle howl. Only fires while the player is on the throttle. Compatible with RPM mods — last write wins per tick.

text.name: nx_menu_loadSpillEnabled_tooltip
text.text: Trailers actually lose their load when tipped past a critical angle. Spilling starts at 15°, ramps to full at 120°; a closed tarp buys an extra 15° of headroom and breaches outright past 60°. About 70% of the spilled volume drops on the ground as a pickupable fill patch (loader-recoverable); the other 30% is lost to scatter. Speed-aware discharge while tipping intentionally — fast tipping flings material further, stationary tipping piles it under the chute. Solid fills only (grain, fertilizer, lime, manure, silage); liquids and cars/trucks are excluded.

text.name: nx_menu_strawRefeedEnabled_tooltip
text.text: A threshing combine with its header lowered over an existing straw windrow picks the straw back up. It passes through the machine and is dropped out of the rear swath again, or chopped and spread if the chopper is on. Only works on land you can access.

text.name: nx_menu_cropDamageEnabled_tooltip
text.text: Wheels flatten crops based on speed instead of all-or-nothing. Below 5 km/h nothing is flattened; faster driving flattens more, near-certain around 40 km/h. Wide tyres, steering, wet ground and heavy vehicles do more damage; row-crop (care) tyres never flatten crops. Only works while the game's Crop Destruction setting is on.

text.name: nx_menu_roadSprayEnabled_tooltip
text.text: Tyres throw water spray on wet asphalt, concrete and bridges. Starts around 12 km/h and builds with speed, road wetness and falling rain; wider tyres throw more. Visual only.

text.name: nx_menu_engineSoundEnabled_tooltip
text.text: Engines carry 180–380 m depending on power and fade like real sound. Far-off engines sound muffled, hills and buildings block them further, and passing vehicles shift pitch. Off restores the game's original ranges.

text.name: nx_menu_neighboursMax_tooltip
text.text: How many neighbour farmers may work open field contracts at the same time (max 10). They use their own lease machines and helpers, free of charge, and always leave at least 3 contracts for you. More neighbours cost more performance.

text.name: nx_menu_hudEnabled_tooltip
text.text: On-screen FarmKit HUD overlay — currently displays the current wheel slip percentage near the speedometer (green / yellow / red).
